blurb: Located in the heart of Downtown Edwardsville, Illinois, The Ink House is one of the most sought-after St. Louis-area event spaces, offering a perfect blend of historic character and modern elegance. Once home to Edwardsville’s longtime local newspaper, this beautifully restored venue sits just one block off Main Street.
